answers.why: Cards lift to feel like objects.

answers.question: elevation.count
answers.why: One shadow for cards, one for overlays.

usage.why: Cards float to feel tactile. In dark a shade cannot be seen, so a lighter surface and a light ring lift them.
Strong depth shows a menu or dialog sits above vivid sections. Without a shadow it blends into the color blocks.

elevation.card.headline: Cards that lift.
elevation.card.line: A clear shadow makes each card feel like an object.

elevation.overlay.headline: Well above the page.
elevation.overlay.line: A deep shadow puts menus and dialogs in front.
